title: Funding Austin Housing & Assistance
summary:
Funding Austin Housing & Assistance

*   Adopted a $42 million operating budget for housing grants and a $1.7 million fund for direct housing assistance for the next fiscal year.
*   Approved a $48.5 million capital budget dedicated to new housing projects and developments.
*   Authorized a service agreement for the Austin Housing Finance Corporation to manage over $90 million in city housing programs.
